description: Per-program resource rules for the Process Lasso-inspired governor tier. 'mode' selects a preset bundle from 'modes' (sleep / low / medium / high); explicit 'defaults' keys override the selected preset, and --no-* / numeric CLI flags override both. 'exclude' keeps a program unmanaged (monitoring only). cpu_limit_percent is a share of total machine CPU (100 = one full core). worker_* keys are the aggregate worker-plane budget/cap; cpu_busy/cpu_extreme are per-core percent; sustain/extreme_sustain are consecutive samples. auto_mode=true enables the native demand-driven advisor (預設自動); the 'auto' block bounds it: 'ceiling' is the highest mode auto-mode may select while the user is active (medium — foreground/user work keeps machine headroom); when the user is idle ≥ idle_after_s the effective ceiling relaxes to idle_ceiling (high — idle full speed), and dropping back below ceiling on return is urgent (streak/cooldown exempt). streak_up/streak_down give hysteresis, cooldown_s bounds downgrades, strain_* force low immediately — smoothed by signal_alpha EMA so a single busy sample cannot demote, while strain_instant_margin keeps extreme spikes urgent — headroom_* gate upgrades (also EMA-smoothed), eval_interval_busy_s shortens the eval interval while strained/overloaded/mid-transition; power_saving_schedule.enabled=true forces nightly 00:00-07:00 sleep mode (睡眠/省電深眠 CPU 5% strict / RAM 30% / VRAM disabled) when auto_mode is active. Per-process dynamic升降: with limiter_dynamic a capped worker's Job rate tightens by limiter_step_percent per cycle while it stays extreme (floor limiter_min_percent) and relaxes toward limiter_percent when demand drops below half the cap; with priority_escalate a process still extreme past sustain+extreme_sustain escalates below_normal→idle and steps back when it drops under extreme (rule-held/pb/bg/foreground exempt). Per-backend-service dynamic control: pool_dynamic resizes each non-interactive pool's shared Job CPU envelope each cycle — machine cpu ≥ pool_relief_cpu_pct (or responsiveness strain / active regulation) tightens by pool_step_percent toward pool_floor_percent; calm + demand at the cap relaxes back toward the preset (the interactive lane is never squeezed). RAM reclamation: with reclaim_enabled, machine mem_used ≥ reclaim_mem_pct makes the governor batch-trim the largest reclaim_min_mb+ working sets (reclaim_batch per cycle, trim cooldown respected; foreground/excluded/governance exempt) to auto-release RAM. GPU/RAM grant reclaim: ACTIVE_PRESSURE scales vram_budget_percent by grant_pressure_vram_scale and new-grant RAM share by grant_pressure_ram_scale, so existing grants resize smaller and cooperating services release VRAM/RAM.

high.description: Throughput-first idle ceiling: workers get up to 80% CPU / 80% RAM / 90% VRAM; no QoS demotion on the worker plane. Only reachable while the user is idle — the advisor drops back urgently on activity.

sleep.description: Sleep/睡眠省電深眠: CPU strict 5% hard cap, RAM 30%, VRAM disabled (CPU-only, no GPU).

background.description: C#/F#/Julia workflow and analysis; deprioritized but never starved (bounded floor via job, not zero).

compute.description: C++/Rust heavy compute: inference, vector, audit, native compute.

pools.description: Pool lanes under the sole governor (second attribution axis beside plane). Members join a per-pool shared Job Object with bounded cpu/memory/process envelopes; 'members' are lowercase substrings matched against exe path + cmdline. Governance plane is never pooled; excluded programs keep pool attribution for telemetry but join no job. Pool members supersede the generic worker-plane job (a process may hold only one Job).

interactive.description: Rust/C/C++ interactive work: UI IPC, RAG query, commands, control.

io.description: Go/Rust IO-bound work: network, file I/O, download, batch.
